question: Which of the following countries launched the world’s first AI-based satellite In May 2025?
solution:
The correct answer is __**China**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• In **May 2025**, **China** successfully launched the **world’s first AI-based satellite**, marking a significant milestone in the integration of artificial intelligence with aerospace technology.
 
• The satellite is equipped with an **on-board AI processing system** that allows it to analyze data in real-time while in orbit, rather than sending vast amounts of raw data back to Earth for processing.
 
• This launch was part of **China's** broader initiative to enhance its **space-based computing** capabilities, significantly reducing the latency involved in satellite communications and **remote sensing** analysis.
 
• The **AI-based satellite** is designed for high-efficiency **autonomous operations**, enabling it to detect and identify specific targets or environmental changes without human intervention from ground control.
